description:
Narrow StorageRacing's blanket rescue: storage_racing.ex:54-55 rescues RuntimeError and labels it {:failure, %{layout_lookup_failed: []}}, which also swallows operation_fn RuntimeErrors raised on the in-process cached-fastest path (line 65) and mislabels them as layout failures. Rescue only the specific raise from LayoutIndex lookup (or convert that lookup to a tagged return) so operation errors propagate honestly.

Scoped down 2026-08-15: the original ticket bundled placeholder/distributor hardening items (restart intensity limit, healthy-TSL invariant, lookup_key! doc nit, hold_ms threading) from the q67.1/q67.3 audits. Those target code that exists only on feature/q67-phase-a, and the doc nit is moot in current LayoutIndex (empty-pid segments filtered at build; storage_racing raises on []). If phase-a merges, re-raise those items under the q67 epic.
title: Narrow StorageRacing blanket rescue: operation_fn RuntimeErrors mislabeled as layout_lookup_failed
